description: Calculate Indian GST on an amount, exact to the paisa: add GST to a price before tax, or take it out of a GST-inclusive price, split into CGST + SGST (sale within a state) or IGST (between states).

price_includes_gst.description: true if the amount already includes GST (default false: GST is added on top).

rate_percent.description: GST rate in percent, e.g. 5, 18 or 40.

supply.description: intra_state (CGST + SGST, the default) or inter_state (IGST).

name: calculate_gst
title: Calculate GST
